## Transferable mechanism summary
Mechanism profile for seed (USB driver probe-time descriptor-array bounds). UNTRUSTED SOURCE: descriptor data supplied at enumeration by a physically attacker-controlled USB device — the contents of usb_host_interface.altsetting[i].desc.bNumEndpoints and the variable-length endpoint[] flex-array per altsetting (also sibling counts bNumInterfaces/num_altsetting); a malicious gadget can omit, reorder, or shrink endpoints/interfaces relative to what a driver assumes for its known device models. MISSING GUARANTEE: no bounds validation of the endpoint array before indexing — code assumes altsetting s has at least k+1 endpoints and never checks altsetting[i].desc.bNumEndpoints > k, neither for altsetting[0] nor re-checked per iteration when looping over num_altsetting; same class includes indexing actconfig->interface[idx] without checking bNumInterfaces. UNSAFE USE: direct fixed-index descriptor reads at probe/bind/init (endpoint[k].desc.bEndpointAddress / .wMaxPacketSize) used to program pipes, and wMaxPacketSize used to compute and store per-altsetting max packet sizes (alt_max_pkt_size[]) that later size/limit URB transfer buffers. Transferable invariant: kernel code must validate an untrusted descriptor-declared length before using a device-model-assumed index into a descriptor array. The seed file cx231xx is a demonstration and never reportable; workers must find the same mechanism elsewhere. BRANCHES: media-epidx=drivers/media/usb/** V4L/DVB USB drivers whose probe/bind/init indexes altsetting[..].endpoint[<literal or assumed k>] (incl. per-altsetting loops reading wMaxPacketSize/bEndpointAddress) without a preceding bNumEndpoints>k check; net-epidx=USB networking drivers (drivers/net/usb/**, drivers/net/wireless and wwan USB NICs) with the same missing endpoint-array bounds check in probe/usbnet bind paths; fixed-epidx-rest=whole-tree sweep outside media-usb and net-usb trees for the same fixed-index endpoint[] access without bNumEndpoints validation (drivers/usb serial/class/misc/storage/atm, sound/usb, hid/input/staging USB drivers); if-alt-count=interface/altsetting-level count validation: actconfig->interface[idx] indexed by assumed or device-derived ifnum without bNumInterfaces check, altsetting[bAlternateSetting]/num_altsetting==0 assumptions, and failure to re-validate endpoints after runtime usb_set_interface/S_ALT switches (excludes .endpoint[] accesses owned by branches 1-3).
